newsitem.title: UK: IOC buys at least one Dubai, 3 VLCCs Qua Iboe - trade.
newsitem.headline: IOC buys at least one Dubai, 3 VLCCs Qua Iboe - trade.

text.p: State-owned Indian Oil Corp (IOC) on Friday bought at least one cargo of Dubai crude and three Very Large Crude Carriers (VLCCs) of Nigerian Qua Iboe in its February tender, European oil traders said.
Traders said the Dubai was taken from Spain's Repsol at first half Dubai quotes +62 cents, but details could not be immediately confirmed with the company.
IOC awarded two VLCCs of Qua Iboe to U.S. major Mobil and one to Swiss-based trader Vitol, traders said.
